messages.text: Is the Nexus QX 1 still available at 8 TH?
Searched the catalog · Nexus QX NerdQX

Yes, the NerdQX 8TH/s is still listed at $299.99, but stock is thin: only the UK plug version is buyable right now. US and EU are both out.

https://heliumdeploy.com/products/nerdqx-8th-s

Specs are ~8 TH/s, ~145W, 4x BM1370, about 40 dB.

Which region are you buying for? If it's US, I can tell you what's actually on the shelf in that range instead.

Then the NerdQX is out for now, the US plug version is sold out and I don't have a restock date I can promise.

Closest thing shipping now is the Hammer Miner BC04, $249, 6 TH/s at about 100W, wifi or ethernet: https://heliumdeploy.com/products/hammer-miner-bc04

If you'd rather put the money toward real hashrate, the Magic Miner 40T is $799 for 40 TH/s, by far the best per terahash we sell. It's a pre-order batch.

What matters more to you, shipping now or hashrate per dollar?

Under $300 and in stock for the US, the Hammer BC04 is the most hashrate per dollar: 6 TH/s, about 100W, $249. That's roughly $41 per TH, and it takes wired ethernet as well as wifi.
https://heliumdeploy.com/products/hammer-miner-bc04

Next closest is the Bitaxe Supra Hex 703, 4.2 TH/s at ~90W for $229, open source but less hashrate for the money.

The B.04 is the one I'd buy. Want me to set up a cart for it?
Read the nexus dual pack page
Searched the catalog · Nexus L1 Dual Pack scrypt

Two Nexus models in the catalog, and only one is buyable right now.

Nexus S1, 10 TH/s at ~150W, $699, US plug in stock: https://heliumdeploy.com/products/nexus-s1-10th-s
Batch 2 is in transit to the US warehouse, so I can't give you a firm date on it yet.

Nexus L1, the Scrypt one, 320 MH/s at ~70W, $399.99, currently sold out in every plug.

Honestly, at $699 for 10 TH/s the S1 isn't great value per terahash next to the BC04 or the Magic Miner 40T.
